scripts.text:
[Juno Guide]
A place that takes the vision of the future, and gives it form in the present. Welcome to
the city of ^8B4513Juno^000000!
scripts.translation:
[朱諾嚮導]
這裡讓未來的願景在當下成為現實。
歡迎來到^8B4513朱諾^000000！

scripts.text:
